MATCH (d:`下游API`)-[rt:`目标服务`]->(svc:`微服务` {`服务名称`: $service}) UNWIND d.serviceContexts AS peer_service MATCH (caller:`方法`)-[rc:`调用` {`关系语义`: '通信边界'}]->(d) MATCH p=(caller)-[rc]->(d)-[rt]->(svc) RETURN DISTINCT 'RPC' AS mechanism, peer_service AS peer_service, svc.nodeId AS target_id, svc.`服务名称` AS target_name, d.nodeId AS api_id, d.caption AS channel, d.`HTTP方法` AS http_method, d.`API路径` AS api_path, caller.nodeId AS caller_id, caller.`全限定名` AS caller_name, p AS path, d AS downstream_api, svc AS target_service

MATCH (pub:`方法`)-[r1:`消息流` {`消息流类型`: '发布至'}]->(ex:`消息交换机`)-[r2:`消息流` {`消息流类型`: '路由至'}]->(q:`消息队列`)-[r3:`消息流` {`消息流类型`: '消费自'}]->(sub:`方法`) WHERE r1.`路由键` = r2.`路由键` AND $service IN pub.serviceContexts UNWIND sub.serviceContexts AS dst_svc MATCH (svc:`微服务` {`服务名称`: dst_svc}) RETURN DISTINCT 'MQ' AS mechanism, 'OUTBOUND' AS direction, svc.nodeId AS peer_id, svc.`服务名称` AS peer_service, q.`队列名称` AS channel, r1.`路由键` AS routing_key, pub, r1, ex, r2, q, r3, sub, svc UNION MATCH (pub:`方法`)-[r1:`消息流` {`消息流类型`: '发布至'}]->(ex:`消息交换机`)-[r2:`消息流` {`消息流类型`: '路由至'}]->(q:`消息队列`)-[r3:`消息流` {`消息流类型`: '消费自'}]->(sub:`方法`) WHERE r1.`路由键` = r2.`路由键` AND $service IN sub.serviceContexts UNWIND pub.serviceContexts AS src_svc MATCH (svc:`微服务` {`服务名称`: src_svc}) RETURN DISTINCT 'MQ' AS mechanism, 'INBOUND' AS direction, svc.nodeId AS peer_id, svc.`服务名称` AS peer_service, q.`队列名称` AS channel, r1.`路由键` AS routing_key, pub, r1, ex, r2, q, r3, sub, svc

results.summary: ts-food-service 双向依赖共6条记录。出向同步RPC：FoodServiceImpl.getAllFood 调用 ts-train-food-service 的 GET /api/v1/trainfoodservice/trainfoods/{tripId}，及 ts-travel-service 的 GET /api/v1/travelservice/routes/{tripId}。入向同步RPC：ts-preserve-service 的 PreserveServiceImpl.createFoodOrder 与 ts-preserve-other-service 的 PreserveOtherServiceImpl.createFoodOrder 均经 POST /api/v1/foodservice/orders 调用本服务。证据中未见异步MQ记录。
